title: Rapid and Accurate Detection of Major Mycobacterium Species in Pulmonary Infection Based on GenSeizer Platform
brief_summary: Comparison of rapid detection methods of mycobacterial pathogens, GenSeizer v.s. PCR reverse hybridization.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Suspected cases of mycobacterial lung infection

Exclusion Criteria:

* No sputum
* Refused or unable to tolerate bronchoscopy
study_population: Suspected cases of mycobacterial lung infection
